scope: Final independent review of the 11 W3C/NIST review-only source excerpt SVGs
decisionRule: Promotion requires every fidelity, visual, mobile-legibility, attribution, governing-notice, no-mark, no-endorsement, contextual-fit, alt-text and caption gate to pass independently.

sharedEvidence.geometry: Each SVG has a 1200 by 1500 viewBox and is rendered as one fixed canvas.
sharedEvidence.mobileLegibility: RECTIFIED: each render now uses a sequential single-column layout with 40px body text and 32px notice text. At a 360 CSS pixel display width these scale to approximately 12px and 9.6px. The full visible excerpt remains available through the dossier's direct SVG open/download control; no column jump remains.
sharedEvidence.marks: No W3C or NIST logo, seal, portrait, figure, photograph or institutional mark appears in any reviewed SVG.
sharedEvidence.endorsement: Every render visibly says Context excerpt only and No affiliation or endorsement, and remains labeled HOLD, REVIEW RENDER, NOT SELECTED OR STAGED.
sharedEvidence.accessibility: Every SVG has role=img, an aria-labelledby relationship, title and description. Those structural features pass; they do not cure unreadable visible text or contextual mismatch.
sharedEvidence.fidelityBasis: The render manifest records a source SHA-256 and exact-wording check for each excerpt. This review accepts those byte/text checks only as provenance evidence; it does not infer that a composite is a screenshot of the original page.
